complete_examples.text: It is apparent that the influence of vehicle number on the tension force of the fastener is much larger than the compressive force of the fastener, which can be seen by comparing Figure 12 with Figure 11.

Only one vehicle is needed if the simulation precision is not strictly required, and two–three vehicles should be considered if the simulation precision is required to research the compressive force of the fastener.
